title: Martian Dust Devils & Electrostatic Cleaning
quickFact: Whirling convective columns of warm air that occasionally sweep dust off rover solar panels.
explore: Martian dust devils are spinning atmospheric vortexes powered by warm ground heating the thin atmosphere. They can tower up to 8 kilometers high! While strong dust storms block solar panels, gentle dust devils have repeatedly saved NASA rovers Spirit and Opportunity by accidentally blowing dust clean off their solar arrays.

refinementConversion.description: Electrostatic telemetry calibrated to predict cleaning events.

checkQuestion.question: How did dust devils unexpectedly assist NASA Mars rovers?
options: They provided wind energy to turn turbines
They blew away accumulated dust from solar panels, restoring power
They delivered moisture to recharge fuel cells
checkQuestion.explanation: Dust devils frequently swept across the rovers, brushing dust off the solar arrays and producing sudden 'cleaning events' that prolonged missions for years.
